name: Radiance Global Group Holdings Limited
summary: Radiance Global Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides civil and structural engineering consultancy services to infrastructural, residential, industrial, commercial, and institutional projects in Singapore, Vietnam, and internationally. The company offers master planning, structural due diligence, and visual inspection services to existing buildings. It also provides geotechnical engineering consultancy services. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in North Point, Hong Kong. Radiance Global Group Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of WMCH Global Holdings Limited.
